newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks up on hope of anti-Bhutto verdict.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks up on hope of anti-Bhutto verdict.

text.p: Pakistani stocks rose at midday on Wednesday on buying of blue chips prompted by what dealers said were hopes that the Supreme Court will not reinstate ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto.
The court's verdict was expected later on Wednesday.

The Karachi 100-share index rose 8.28 points, or 0.55 percent, to 1,509.12 amid 93 gainers and 78 losers at noon. Brokers expected the court to rule against Bhutto, clearing the way for Monday's general election to go ahead, one dealer said.
PTCL rose 1.15 rupees to 32.80, HUBCO 0.30 38.45 and Dewan Salman 0.40 to 35.90. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
